today.principal-smart.name: Principal at work · change over the period
today.principal-smart.definition: MBQL on model 74: Outstanding Principal (max) by Date, filtered by Period on Date. Smart scalar shows the latest completed-day value and the change against the first date in the period. Whole baht.

today.realization.name: Interest this month · share of projection
today.realization.definition: MBQL on model 73: field Forecast Realization (Realized Profit MTD ÷ Projected Monthly Profit). Progress goal 1 shows the share of the projected month collected so far; the card description names the projected amount source.

today.collection-rate.name: Collected today · share of amount due
today.collection-rate.definition: MBQL on model 73: field Amount Collection Rate Today (Amount Collected Today ÷ Amount Due Today). Progress goal 1. Reused on Today and Collection.

cash.pool-selected.name: Total cash pool · selected date
cash.pool-selected.definition: Native, same routing as question 207: today reads model 73 Total Cash Pool, a past date reads model 205 Total Cash Pool for that date; blank when no snapshot exists.

cash.principal-selected.name: Principal outstanding · selected date
cash.principal-selected.definition: Native, same routing as question 207, selecting Outstanding Principal.

income.vs-previous.name: This period and the previous period
income.vs-previous.basis: snippet 2 Income statement period (model 186 Income Events)
income.vs-previous.definition: Native: for the selected statement period and the immediately preceding period of equal length, Income, Expenses, Net profit, Days and Net per day, plus change % of each. Two rows (This period, Previous period) and one Change row. Whole baht, one-decimal percent.

settings.table.column_formatting: change row: positive green, negative red

income.monthly.name: Monthly income, expenses and net profit
income.monthly.definition: MBQL on model 186: sum Income, sum Expenses and sum (Income − Expenses) by Date month, filtered to the previous five complete months plus the current month. Current month is partial and labelled "to date" in the card description.

cashflow.by-type-row.name: Cash movement by transaction type · chart
cashflow.by-type-row.basis: snippet 3 Cashflow statement period (same query as question 203)
cashflow.by-type-row.definition: Native: question 203's query unchanged, displayed as a horizontal bar of Money in and Money out per transaction type. Question 203 stays the table beside it.

perf.vs-previous.name: This period and the previous period
perf.vs-previous.basis: models 71 Repayment Ledger and 70 Loan Book (pattern of questions 217–219)
perf.vs-previous.definition: Native: for the selected Period and the preceding period of equal length, Gross interest, Principal issued, Loans issued and Principal returned, with change %. Same date rules as questions 217–219 (loan dates and payment dates both use the filter).

settings.table.column_formatting: change row: positive green, negative red

partners.capital-share-row.name: Capital share · full pool
partners.capital-share-row.basis: model 318 Partners · position source (same query as question 331)
partners.capital-share-row.definition: Native: question 331's query unchanged, displayed as a horizontal bar with the share percent as the value label. Replaces the two-slice pie.
